instruments: APXS; ChemCam; MAHLI; Mastcam; CheMin; SAM
what_was_done: APXS showed suitable chemistry; ChemCam rastered a light vein; MAHLI at 5 cm. Hole drilled and sample delivered to CheMin and SAM; then images and chemistry of the hole wall and tailings.
Ridge with at least three larger layers, some parallel and others inclined, and clear sedimentary structures; high-resolution Mastcam mosaics.
Rover parked inside the Mojo hollow; mosaics of the ridges, a trough and the hollow floor to look for regolith movement.

location: large hollow, sand and pebble floor
what_was_done: Hollow chosen for the first drill hole in the boxwork; floor covered in sand and pebbles, target ridge ~2 m above it; wall and textures imaged.
Curiosity's 44th drill hole. Triage with chemistry in the expected range; sample delivered to CheMin (X-ray diffraction) and SAM (gases: H2O, CO2, SO2); ChemCam on the hole and tailings.

location: ridge top, ~10 m from Valle de la Luna
what_was_done: Chemistry in family with other ridge tops; hole completed on sol 4718; CheMin to compare ridge mineralogy with the hollow's; SAM (evolved gas and GCMS for organics).
New hole a few cm from the first, for the SAM experiment with the last TMAH reagent; ChemCam made two attempts inside the hole.

target: Polygons in the Monte Grande hollow
what_was_done: Block next to Valle de la Luna covered in polygons (only seen now, since the rover had blocked the view); APXS and LIBS on centers and ridges; MAHLI mosaic for a 3D model.

location: east boundary of the boxwork unit
what_was_done: Rover follows the east contact with the neighboring geology; mosaics of light rock across the contact, of a butte to the south and of ridges, for structures and stratigraphy.

location: south boundary, with the sulfate unit
sol_confidence: planned part in the post; reference sol
what_was_done: Series of mosaics of the south contact with the sulfate unit, including the Paniri butte; on sol 4845, third crossing of the contact. The 4845-4851 post already describes the polygonal sulfate unit outside the boxwork.
